current_prompt.body:
READ the list L of 45 distinct positive integers:
{71, 97, 54, 56, 44, 158, 45, 58, 82, 135, 113, 117, 86, 40, 12, 185, 63, 50, 111, 72, 90, 109, 61, 13, 92, 60, 91, 35, 114, 94, 105, 26, 15, 51, 102, 118, 76, 32, 108, 23, 22, 134, 83, 43, 64}
DETERMINE whether the set can be partitioned into N=15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) satisfying a_i + b_i = c_i for each i
IF a valid partition exists THEN
OUTPUT one complete example of the triples (a_i, b_i, c_i)
ENDIF
